shared_elements: upright rectangular stone block/pillar as the carved support
low-relief carving cut into a rough stone surface
curving/arcing incised lines crossing the surface
small isolated geometric motif set within a larger field
justification: Both are upright stone monoliths bearing shallow-relief carving with long curving lines and a small discrete geometric motif, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is organised as a complete frontal anthropomorphic figure with head, arms, banded belt and a prominent central disc in deep, dark, heavily worn relief, while B shows a sparse, pale, very low-relief animal and abstract lines with no overall figural framework or comparable ordering.
